primary_hypothesis.statement: A provenance-diverse reversal gate layered over context-bound fast/slow ClayGraph bindings can sharply reduce false relation reversals caused by correlated source echo while preserving near-baseline adaptation to genuine reversals at moderate observation noise.
mechanism: Context is part of binding identity; contradictory contexts need not globally overwrite one another.
Fast state reacts to recent evidence but does not directly become durable semantic topology.
Promotion requires bounded-window contradiction support, fast-state agreement and multiple provenance families rather than raw repetition count.
The previous durable binding is versioned/archived or suppressed, never silently deleted.
Activation, promotion and provenance diversity do not mint truth or execution authority.
primary_hypothesis.prediction: Compared with signed scalar EMA and ungated fast/slow baselines, RAB will lower false-reversal error under duplicated/correlated-source bursts by a large margin while adding little true-reversal lag for moderate noise; the advantage should disappear if provenance diversity is irrelevant or incorrectly modeled.
falsifiers: No material false-reversal reduction over simpler baselines under source-echo attacks.
True-reversal adaptation lag or task loss grows enough to erase the robustness gain.
A context-aware scalar baseline matches RAB under provenance-echo stress without extra state.
Source-family spoofing or ancestry mistakes routinely bypass the gate.
Replay/rollback cannot reconstruct the same promoted/suppressed binding sequence.
Live H1/H2 traces show no predictive or outcome benefit from provenance-diverse gating.

counterhypotheses.statement: A signed context-aware scalar EMA is sufficient; fast/slow shadow promotion adds complexity without causal or operational benefit.
Most apparent RAB benefit comes from context partitioning, not provenance diversity.
Provenance-diversity thresholds over-stabilize memory and cause harmful adaptation delay under high noise, sparse-source regimes or rapid genuine reversals.
Provenance-family identity is too fallible or gameable to serve as a reliable reversal gate; correlated sources can masquerade as independent support.
A single authoritative source can legitimately establish a rapid reversal, so mandatory multi-source diversity would be incorrect without a separately typed authority/evidence path.

boundary_cases: Same relation is positive in context A and negative in context B: fork/preserve context-specific bindings; do not classify as global reversal.
One highly authoritative exact source changes value: use a separately typed exact-evidence/update path; do not fake independence through duplicates.
Many copies share one ancestry: count as one provenance family for reversal diversity.
Out-of-order/stale event arrives after promotion: epoch validity and replay identity decide admissibility; arrival time alone does not reverse.
Conflict remains unresolved: keep SHADOW/CONFLICT/UNKNOWN rather than forcing a winner.
Exact identity lookup: retain G3 BYPASS/capped graph-propagation rule.
